source.prompt: Melodic organic house song, about 3.5 minutes, 119 BPM, F# minor. Warm dusk mood, dreamy and hopeful, slowly opening up. Airy, intimate female lead vocal with soft stacked harmonies on the chorus. Breathy flute melody, harp plucks, lush string section pad, felt piano chords, rolling warm bass. Four-on-the-floor soft kick, offbeat open hats, claps on 2 and 4, congas and shaker. Structure: instrumental intro (16 bars), verse, pre-chorus, chorus, short instrumental break, verse 2, chorus, stripped bridge, final chorus, instrumental outro that fades. Clean, wide mix with a tight mono low end.
source.lyrics:
[Intro]
Mmm, ooh

[Verse]
The day lets go of the hillside slow
Long shadows stretching over the stone
You hum a tune that I almost know
And the road forgets the way back home

[Pre-Chorus]
Nothing to hurry, nothing to prove
The whole sky is turning, and so are you

[Chorus]
Leaning into amber, leaning into you
Every breath gets lighter, every word rings true
Let the evening hold us, let the colours run
Leaning into amber, chasing down the sun

[Verse]
Cedar and woodsmoke drift through the air
Bare feet are dancing on warm old ground
Gold in your laughter, gold in your hair
I could stay lost and never be found

[Pre-Chorus]
Nothing to hurry, nothing to prove
The whole sky is turning, and so are you

[Chorus]
Leaning into amber, leaning into you
Every breath gets lighter, every word rings true
Let the evening hold us, let the colours run
Leaning into amber, chasing down the sun

[Bridge]
Slow, slow, let the light go
Slow, slow, I already know

[Chorus]
Leaning into amber, leaning into you
Every breath gets lighter, every word rings true
Let the evening hold us, let the colours run
Leaning into amber, chasing down the sun
